connector.name: MCP by crisphive.com
connector.registryDescription: Agentic scheduling & booking for field service: availability, jobs, customers, crews, fleet.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.crisphive.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.crisphive, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CRISPHIVE_API_KEY
env.description: Crisphive Developer API key (chsk_live_... = production data, chsk_test_... = isolated sandbox). Create one in the dashboard under Developers -> API keys.

env.name: CRISPHIVE_BASE_URL
env.description: API origin override. Defaults to https://api.crisphive.com.
